notes.title: Slingshottr 0.44.2 Changelog
notes.content:
Merry Christmas scrappers! This is likely to be the last update this year! 

The main focus of this update is the addition of the merchant station, where players can buy upgrades. This allows more potential for strategy when choosing upgrades than the previous system.

[u]Additions[/u]
+ Players now receive money for depositing scrap. All players receive income regardless of who scrapped.
+ Upgrades are now purchased from merchant stations, which are available every 5 sectors. Tether to access the shop.
+ Small wreckages with informational logs will now spawn. Tether them to read.

[u]Modifications[/u]
- Temporarily disabled rocket barrage upgrade.
- Upgrades are no longer randomly dropped.

[u]Fixes[/u]
+ Fixed mouse tooltips not appearing for some objects.

notes.title: Slingshottr 0.43.12 Changelog
notes.content:
Hey scrappers,

Smallish patch today, adding a new biome-specific enemy (immune to most attacks), alongside some balancing.

notes.title: Slingshottr 0.41.9 Changelog
notes.content:
[h2]Hello scrappers![/h2]

This is the first content patch since Slingshottr went into public early access on Monday.
[b]
0.41.9 Changelog[/b]
[u]Additions[/u]
+ Added upgrade: Scrap Magnet.
+ Added upgrade: Pitstop.
+ Added upgrade: Rocket Barrage.
+ Added scrap: Medical Pallet.
+ Added banner for rank up.
+ Added rank promotion progress bar.
+ Added button ui sounds.

[u]Modifications[/u]
- Increased defence drone damage.
- Modified intros.
- Removed unused input mappings.
- Increased length of time title banners are shown (e.g. upgrade pickup).
- Improved sentry behaviour and art.
- Prevent tethering passive NPCs (for now).
- Modified black hole art.
- Modified ship unlock requirements.

[u]Fixes[/u]
- Fixed rammer pirate speed bug.
